description: This file contains unit tests for the CopyProjectActivityAPI class in the OrangeHRM Time API plugin. The tests verify the behavior of 'getAll' and 'create' methods, and also include tests for unimplemented methods 'delete' and 'getValidationRuleForDelete'.

classes.name: CopyActivityAPITest
classes.description: A test class extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase to test the CopyProjectActivityAPI endpoints related to copying activities in the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of the CopyProjectActivityAPI to ensure it retrieves all copy activities correctly.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the 'testGetAll' test method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the 'create' method of the CopyProjectActivityAPI to ensure it creates copy activities correctly.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the 'testCreate' test method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that calling delete on the API throws a 'NotImplemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that calling getValidationRuleForDelete on the API throws a 'NotImplemented' exception.
